chapter: Advice to youth and the art of drumming
title: Cymbals have grown
summary: Cymbals were small and thick in 1934, and both men used heavy brass cymbals as bottom hi-hats.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Yeah, they were growing -- well, back in '34 --
Right, well, that was about the biggest thing you could get at that time. And then they used to have those old thick cymbals, so thick until -- they were almost like a gong.
Yeah, we used to call them brass cymbals because (inaudible).
I used to use that on the bottom of a high hat when I first started.
Yeah, right, right, I did, too, I did, too, and then have a thin one on top.
